description: This file contains utility functions for hashing and redacting identifiers using SHA-256, primarily providing a way to anonymize or obscure string identifiers.

methods.name: export function sha256HexPrefix(value: string, len = 12): string { sha256HexPrefix
methods.description: Hashes a string with SHA-256 and returns a hexadecimal prefix of specified length (default 12).

methods.name: export function redactIdentifier(value: string | undefined, opts?: { len?: number }): string { redactIdentifier
methods.description: Redacts an identifier by hashing it with SHA-256 and prefixing with 'sha256:'. Returns '-' if the input is undefined or empty.
